question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"through."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Through"** means to go from one side of something to the other side. ((किसी वस्‍तु के) इस पार से उस पार; आर-पार) • It can also mean to finish something completely. • In this context, **"through"** is the correct option as it fits the sentence structure and makes sense in the given sentence. • **Example**: *I've got some work to do but I should be **through**__ in an hour if you can wait.* • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: He __opened__ his eyes. Moonlight was shining __through__ the bars on the window. And ______ (3) _______ was goggling through the ______ (4) ______ at him: a freckle-faced, red-haired, long-nosed someone. Ron Weasley was outside Harry's ______ (5) _______.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Complete"** means to finish something or make it whole. It is not the correct option in this context as it doesn't fit the sentence structure. (संपूर्ण; सर्वांशपूर्ण, सारा) • **"Though"** is a conjunction used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict the previous statement. It is not the correct option in this context as it doesn't fit the sentence structure. (किसी बात के बावजूद; यद्यपि, हालाँकि) • **"In" **is a preposition used to indicate location or position within something. It is not the correct option in this context as it doesn't fit the sentence structure. ((पूर्वसर्ग) (स्‍थान का निर्देश) अंदर या किसी क्षेत्र या वस्‍तु के भीतर कोई स्थिति में, के अंदर) 44:Tcde, The correct answer is **"someone."**
